samples: This program prints a simple Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion table to the console, covering temperatures from -10 to 40 in steps of 10. It also provides a reusable conversion function that turns any Celsius decimal into Fahrenheit using the standard formula. If you need a tiny, dependency-light utility for displaying temperature conversions, this is straightforward and easy to use.
